text: Ellie has a second interview at the council on Thursday at 2pm. She's really nervous, says the first panel grilled her. Text her good luck Thursday morning.
Isabel and her husband are moving to Leeds sometime in the spring. Her mum's not thrilled about it.
Oliver applied for the senior analyst role at Barclays, hears back after Christmas apparently
need to ring Fiona tomorrow evening about her dad's op
Matteo's sister Julia got into the Royal College of Music!! Starts September 2027. He's so proud
Coffee w Mai. Her cat Biscuit had a tooth out last week, all fine now. She's vegan these days, so no cake for her bday
So Isla rang, um, her interview at the hospital got moved to the 12th at half 9 instead of the 10th. She said she's dreading the presentation bit. I should send her a message the night before.
Jada's leaving do is Friday at 6, the Crown. I'm bringing the card round for people to sign.
Siobhan Walsh, ex colleague, now head of HR at Okafor & Partners. Into bouldering. Lives in Clapham.

Bumped into Rafael at the station. The wedding's off, he and Anya split up last month, which explains why he's been so quiet in the group chat. He's moved back in with his parents for now and says he's fine but he really didn't look it. Check in with him at the weekend, maybe suggest a pint.
Karan - grad scheme application due 2 November 2026. wants me to read his cover letter before then. do it Sunday
Pick up dry cleaning, renew passport before March 2027
Zainab's nan passed away on Monday. Funeral's sometime next week, she's not sure when yet. Her brother Ahmed is flying back from Dubai for it. Must send flowers.
Seo-yeon passed her driving test today, third try! Send congrats
Krisztina mentioned her son's starting nursery in January, she's anxious about leaving him
Jess (Jessie to everyone at work) got the promotion to team lead. Starts after half term. Her partner Miriam is throwing a little party for her on Saturday night.
Dorota says she's applying for jobs in Kraków, wants to be closer to her parents. Maybe by summer.
Claire's dog Rolo got out again lol. Found him two streets away

Talked to Anders after the match. His knee's still bad, physio twice a week, and the surgeon wants another scan on 6 January 2027. He's hoping to be back playing by the spring at the latest. His wife Keisha is due in February, their second, and he's trying to get the nursery decorated before then. Their eldest, Oliver, keeps asking if it's a brother.
Remind me to ask Caroline how the interview at the BBC went, it was yesterday afternoon
Ioana's birthday 14th Nov. She keeps going on about wanting a proper espresso machine

Afua told me her mum's having a hip replacement on the 3rd of December, 8am at St Thomas'. Afua's taking a week off to look after her and she's a bit overwhelmed with it all. I said I'd do the school run Tuesday. Must ring her on the 4th to see how the op went.
dmitri petrov - interview w the recruiter fri 11am. phone screen only. he's fine abt it
Nina's back from Lisbon. She and Matteo got engaged out there!!!

voice note: right so Joanna and Oliver are hosting Christmas this year at theirs, both families, and she's already stressed about it because his parents don't really get on with hers. She asked if I'd bring dessert. Also Oliver's going for a job at Deloitte, final round is early December sometime, she didn't know the date. I need to text her next week to see how she's holding up.
Ellie's little brother Sam is doing his GCSE mocks after Christmas
Mrs Murphy next door - grandson's christening Sunday at 11. she asked if I'd feed the cat Pebbles while she's away
Need to finish my own application for the Edinburgh job by Friday at 5pm. Ask Isabel for a reference first.
Fiona said her daughter Isla got the offer from Bristol!! Fiona's over the moon, bit sad she'll be far away though
Mai's flying to Hanoi on 18 December 2026, back 8 January. Seeing her grandparents. Ask her for photos when she's back
Santiago Barros. Met at Karan's party. Works in fintech, plays bass in a covers band. Gig at the Fiddler's Elbow sometime next month
jada asked me to look over her CV tonight, she's applying for the Head of Ops role. closing date this Friday midnight

Keisha's 40th is in March 2027, the 19th I think. Anders wants to do a surprise trip to Rome for the long weekend, flights Friday at 7am. I'm in charge of getting her friends to keep the dates free without her finding out, which will be hard with Siobhan. Gift idea from him: she's been eyeing a Polaroid camera for ages.
Anya seemed low today. New job's not what she expected and her manager's on her case constantly. Maybe take her for lunch next week.
Dentist moved to Wed 9:15.
Rafael's daughter Ellie has her first ballet recital on the 30th at 4pm. He asked if I'd come. Don't forget to get her flowers for after
Siobhan's grandad Uncle Pat as everyone calls him turns 90 on New Year's Day. Big family do at a hotel in Galway.
Krisztina Dubois - Krissy - starts at Google on Monday. Message her Monday evening to see how day one went
zainab's back at work, says she's doing ok but tired. her brother ahmed stayed on another few weeks to help their dad
Claire & Dmitri's anniversary dinner on Saturday got cancelled, he's got covid. Poor them.

Ioana did her PhD viva on Monday morning, three hours apparently, and she's now waiting on the outcome, should hear sometime in the new year. She's convinced she failed (she won't have). Her supervisor Dr Okafor said the examiners seemed happy. She's also applying for postdocs in Amsterdam, first deadline 15 January 2027.
Talked to Joanna at pickup. Her son Oliver's been struggling at his new school, kids not very welcoming. She's meeting his teacher Friday at 3.30. Check in with her over the weekend.
Nina's gluten free, remember for dinner on the 8th

Matteo had his interview with the Tate on Tuesday morning. Thinks it went well, they said they'd let him know in a couple of weeks. If he gets it he'd start in the new year and have to give notice at the gallery, which his boss won't love. Nina's keeping everything crossed for him. Ask him at the end of the month if there's news.
Seo-yeon and her girlfriend Jada are doing the Great North Run next September. Training starts in the spring.

Note to self: Miriam's mum, Dr Le, retires end of this month after 35 years as a GP. Miriam's organising a surprise do for her on the 31st at 7. Need to chip in for the present, Miriam's collecting by Wednesday.
Caroline didn't get the BBC job. Gutted. She's going to apply again in the spring when they re-advertise.

Isabel's dad got made redundant on Friday. She's worried about him, he's 58 and doesn't think anyone will hire him. He's got an interview lined up with a logistics firm in a couple of weeks but he's lost all his confidence. Her mum's trying to stay positive. Isabel asked if I knew anyone at Network Rail. Call her tomorrow night and ask Karan if his cousin still works there.
Keisha said Anders hates surprises. Good to know
Fiona's off to Canada for a month sometime after Easter, visiting her sister Julia in Vancouver
Dorota's cat Kiwi is having an operation tomorrow morning, she's a wreck about it. Text her at lunchtime.
Ahmed Ibrahim (Zainab's brother). Architect, lives in Dubai, massive Arsenal fan. Getting married in Dubai in October 2027, I think invites are coming soon.

Big catch up with Afua and her husband. They're house hunting in Bristol, want to move by summer. He's had an offer from a firm there, starts 1 March 2027. Afua's a bit apprehensive, she'll need to find a new job herself and she's been at the same school for ten years. Their eldest, Isla, is not happy about changing schools. Afua's got a couple of interviews lined up already, one next Tuesday at 10am and one early in the new year. Should send her that job listing I saw at Clifton College.
Jess's first week as team lead done. She said it's been a lot but she's loving it.
Santiago's band gig moved to 22 November 2026 at 9pm. I said I'd go, bringing Karan
Book MOT. Sort gas bill.
Ellie got the council job!!! Starts in January. Must get her a bottle of something nice
Mai said her mum's coming to stay over Christmas for three weeks. Mai's already exhausted thinking about it lol
Dmitri's still recovering, back at work maybe next week. Claire's rebooked their anniversary dinner for the 15th at 8. Drop them a message to say happy anniversary on the day
Rang Nan. She's fine, garden's a mess, wants me to come help in the spring.
